easy.def: A person who lives near you.
examples: My neighbor has a big dog.

more.def: A person who lives next to or near you.
examples: Our neighbor waters our plants when we are away.
Canada is a neighbor of the United States.
The girl who sits next to me in class is a good neighbor.
I feel nervous on the first day of school.
The nervous cat hid under the bed.
I get nervous at the dentist.

more.def: Worried or a little afraid about something that is going to happen.
examples: She felt nervous before her piano recital.
He was nervous about meeting his new teacher.
The nervous horse jumped at every sound.
